dog.description_text: Meet Verily! Verily is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. She is currently with one of our wonderful foster families. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FVerily%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQpejLK03P4aS7fOkV2O5j3REgUCNhrbdUzT0rshl9bAIDZWHg Her foster says " She has become more playful and never is bored of exploring every inch of her new space, but she isn't overly energetic and often is quiet and calm. Completely okay being home alone for several hours and likes to sit by your side whenever she can at home (tip: pull up a chair next to you while you are at a table). A perfect cat for someone who wants a companion but doesn't want to be overly clung to. Verily is basically roommate who is a little more orange and a little more fluffy :). She is a nice calm companion who is always nearby, but does not overwhelm you with needs of attention. She is very capable of entertaining herself and is funny to watch her explore anything she can find. Whenever she is curious you can tell by her very loud sniffing, she definitely was a beagle/hound in another life. Also secretly loves getting her photo taken. Over time Verily’s personality has mellowed and she has become a lot more comfortable coming to cuddle. She has been great when meeting new people and was warmed up quickly to a friend cat sitting for a couple days. Very food motivated and independent. She allows for more pets and is infinitely less stressed and anxious. She has more bravery to say good morning and politely ask when she can have her food!" She is calm , sweet , and playful. She is affectionate and enjoys being pet. Verily is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps.
